# Caleb Stacy

Caleb Stacy is a senior content designer working across product strategy, interaction language,
onboarding, experimentation, content governance, terminology, and AI-assisted content systems.

Canonical portfolio: https://calebstacy.com/
Resume: https://calebstacy.com/resume.html
Work samples: https://calebstacy.com/samples.html
Contact: https://www.linkedin.com/in/caleb-stacyrva/

## Selected work

### Meta Horizon NUX

Caleb replaced a front-loaded VR tutorial syllabus with education attached to the moment and
control that needed it. The case study includes his author-recorded outcomes, measured against
the onboarding it replaced: a 13 percent lift in first-world visits and a 7 percent retention lift.

https://calebstacy.com/nux.html

### Portals

Caleb defined the information and choice model for embodied travel in Meta Horizon. The portal
reveals identity, context, presence, and actions as someone approaches. It shipped and appeared
at Meta Connect 2024. The case study scopes its experiment results to the whole portal surface,
including the Go action, not to metadata alone.

https://calebstacy.com/portals.html

### Verso

Caleb created Verso, a content design agent that treats product strings as design decisions. It
checks drafts against a product's measured voice and governed sources, finds existing patterns,
and returns a recommendation with evidence and tradeoffs. The overview explains its agent,
measurement engine, and governed index together on one page.

https://calebstacy.com/verso.html
